events.title: 2nd Annual Moapa River Social Pow Wow 2026
events.details: Join the Moapa community for the 2nd Annual Moapa River Social Pow Wow on Friday, November 6, and Saturday, November 7, 2026, at Veteran’s Park in Moapa, Nevada! This free, public event will bring together dancers, drum groups, families, and visitors for a weekend celebrating Native American culture, music, dancing, and community. Hosted by the Moapa community, this two-day gathering will feature grand entries, gourd dancing, handgame tournaments, horseshoe competitions, a drum contest, special dance competitions, and live entertainment featuring Supaman, an MTV Video Music Award winner and Native American music award winner. Everyone is welcome to attend and experience the energy, traditions, and community spirit of this special event! EVENT DETAILS Event: 2nd Annual Moapa River Social Powwow Dates: Friday, November 6 – Saturday, November 7, 2026 Location: Veteran’s Park Address: I-15, Exit 75 – Valley of Fire, Moapa, NV 89025 Admission: Free and open to the public Host Community: Moapa River Indian Reservation / Moapa community Important: No drugs or alcohol are allowed at this event. FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2026 – EVENT SCHEDULE • 4:00 PM: Dancer registration opens • 6:00 PM: Gourd dancing • 7:00 PM: Grand Entry Friday will also feature the Horseshoe Doubles Tournament, with prize amounts of $1,000 and $2,000, as well as the Handgame Bonehog, where the winner takes the pot.
